basis: Cerebellar degeneration and motor axonal neuropathy; muscle atrophy in 6/13 is neurogenic, without established direct muscle disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: atrophy in 6/13 reflects motor denervation; common secondary wasting does not establish direct muscle involvement.

basis: Retinal capillary telangiectasia and aneurysms define this vascular lesion, causing macular edema, degeneration and visual loss.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: abnormal retinal capillaries and arteriolar/venular aneurysms define the disease; these vessels fall within the cardiovascular axis.

basis: Brain and cutaneous capillary malformations define the syndrome; optic atrophy 6/8. Short distal phalanges 19/20 omitted under cap, prioritizing severe visual damage.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: cutaneous capillary malformations are a defining feature, present in 10/10.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none under four-axis cap: short distal phalanges occur in 19/20, but severe optic atrophy takes priority over this limited skeletal anomaly.

basis: Defining hair and skin dysplasia plus malformed teeth and enamel hypoplasia; syndactyly is explicitly cutaneous.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: the definition specifies partial cutaneous syndactyly, without established bone, joint or muscle involvement.

basis: Inherited motor neuron degeneration; muscle wasting and ventilatory weakness result from denervation rather than direct muscle or lung disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: denervation atrophy is common, but the disease directly targets motor neurons rather than skeletal muscle.

basis: Pontocerebellar and spinal motor neuron disease; muscle wasting is neurogenic. Retinal dystrophy is 5-29%; renal microangiopathy is not established in >=30%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: characteristic wasting is due to motor neuron loss; contractures have unspecified frequency and do not establish common direct musculoskeletal disease.

basis: Thymic endocrine-cell neoplasm; vena cava abnormalities and collateral veins are frequent (30-79% HPO), supporting tumor-related venous obstruction. Cough alone adds no pulmonary axis.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: vena cava abnormalities and prominent trunk veins, each 30-79% by HPO, support direct tumor-related venous obstruction.

basis: Benign myofibroblastic tumor of lymph-node stroma; neither a blood-cell neoplasm nor lymphoma. Nodal stroma is outside the specified axes.

decisions.haematologic: none: nodal location does not make a stromal tumor a disease of blood cells, marrow, coagulation or splenic blood function.

basis: PPCS deficiency is an established inborn defect of coenzyme A biosynthesis presenting with dilated cardiomyopathy; elevated lactate alone would not justify the metabolic axis.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: this specific disorder is PPCS enzyme deficiency impairing coenzyme A biosynthesis, an inborn metabolic disorder, rather than merely a cardiomyopathy with elevated lactate.

basis: Neurodevelopmental impairment and joint/skeletal abnormalities characterize the syndrome; joint hypermobility 20/20. JMML is a separately diagnosed predisposition; cardiac frequency unclear.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: joint and skeletal abnormalities are defining manifestations, supported by joint hypermobility in 20/20 patients.
